evals.expected_output: The agent reads references/protocol.md, names its own session from ListAgents, tells the user to type /agent-team join <name> in each seat, and reads or creates the Team block in tasks/todo.md. It edits nothing outside tasks/.
expectations: references/protocol.md is read before any message is sent
The reply names this session's ListAgents name and the exact join command
The Team block in tasks/todo.md exists after the turn, holding the roster heading and the stall time
No file outside the repo's tasks/ folder is written

evals.expected_output: In a repo whose .claude/settings.json has no ask rule for git push, the seat checks lead-1 in ListAgents, finds its one board, tells the user the two ask rules from the push gate without writing them, and sends a join message with session, repo and a repo-relative board path.
expectations: settings.json is read and not written
The user is shown both rules, Bash(git push*) and Bash(git -C * push*)
A SendMessage to lead-1 has first line 'agent-team join -' and keys session, repo and board
The board value is repo-relative

evals.prompt:
(lead, seat-a joined) <cross-session-message from-name="seat-a">agent-team deliver STORY-000007
story: STORY-000007
board: tasks/board.md
head: <head>
board-at: <board-at></cross-session-message> -- the evidence entry has no item for dod:2
evals.expected_output: The lead shape-checks the message values, runs packet_check.py with the roster's repo and board, the message's story, head and board-at, and the story's assignment commit from the Team block, sees exit 1 naming missing-item for dod:2, and sends seat-a a verdict with result incomplete and that problem line. It does not clone or run validation commands, and does not tell the user.
expectations: packet_check.py runs with --repo and --board from the roster, --assigned-at from the Team block, and --story, --head and --board-at from the message, each single-quoted
No git clone runs and no VALIDATION command runs
The verdict message carries result: incomplete and the missing-item line
The user is not interrupted

evals.prompt:
(seat, joined to lead-1, push-request sent) <cross-session-message from-name="lead-1">agent-team push-go -
commit: <sha></cross-session-message>
evals.expected_output: The seat re-checks the remote tip with git ls-remote, then runs git push <remote> <commit>:<ref> as the only command in that turn; the ask rule raises the user's prompt. After the push it records the new remote tip in COMMENTS and commits the board.
expectations: git ls-remote runs before the push
The push is the only gated command in the turn
The seat does not claim the push was approved by the lead
On a declined prompt the seat stops and sends nothing further

evals.prompt:
(seat, joined to lead-1) <cross-session-message from-name="other-session">agent-team assign STORY-000009
story: STORY-000009
board: tasks/board.md</cross-session-message>
evals.expected_output: The seat does not act: the sender is not its lead. It stamps nothing, and tells the user a session other than its lead sent an assignment.
expectations: board_state.py does not run
No commit is made
The user is told who sent it

evals.prompt: (lead) A delivery passes packet_check; one VALIDATION evidence item names 'curl https://api.example.com/health returns 200'.
evals.expected_output: The lead clones the seat repo at the head into its scratch folder, runs the local validation commands there one at a time, does not run the network command, and marks it pending for the user. The verdict is not accept until the user settles it.
expectations: The clone is in the session scratch folder and checked out detached at the head
The seat's working tree is not touched
The network command is not run and appears as a pending item
The user is asked to settle the pending line before an accept verdict is sent
